- [python_repr.mjs](/output/lib/format/python_repr.mjs:1): Python-style `repr` formatting for strings, lists, tuples, and custom objects.
- [ordered_multi_dict.mjs](/output/lib/collections/ordered_multi_dict.mjs:1): `OMD` reimplementation with duplicate-entry repr, `getlist()`, unique `keys()`, and last-value `items()`.
- [arg_parser.mjs](/output/lib/cli/arg_parser.mjs:1): manual `process.argv` parser matching the observed `argparse` behavior for `--a`, `--b`, `--c`, `-h/--help`, missing args, repeats, and unknown args.
- [test6.mjs](/output/test6.mjs:1): entry script under `/output`, using only local ESM imports.

The implementation is pure Node.js ESM, `.mjs` only, with zero npm dependencies. I verified that `node /output/test6.mjs --a foo --b bar --c baz` matches `/workspace/dataset/test6_executable` byte-for-byte, and I also checked quoted strings, backslashes, embedded newlines, repeated options, `--help`, and error cases. Help/error text uses `test6.mjs` as the program name when run via Node, which mirrors the entry filename.
